Package com.nexuslink.protocol.redis

Interface RedisPubSubEvent

All Known Implementing Classes:
RedisMessage, RedisSubscriptionEvent
public sealed interface RedisPubSubEvent permits RedisMessage, RedisSubscriptionEvent
A decoded Redis Pub/Sub push frame: either a delivered RedisMessage or a RedisSubscriptionEvent confirmation.

Pub/Sub frames arrive as a RESP2 array (leading *) or a RESP3 push (leading >), with the first element naming the frame kind: 

   subscribe    ["subscribe",   channel, count]
   unsubscribe  ["unsubscribe", channel, count]
   psubscribe   ["psubscribe",  pattern, count]
   punsubscribe ["punsubscribe",pattern, count]
   message      ["message",     channel, payload]
   pmessage     ["pmessage",    pattern, channel, payload]

parse(RespValue) turns one such frame (already decoded by RespCodec) into the matching event — this is the pure, transport-free heart of the subscriber and is unit-tested directly against raw RESP bytes.
